title: Multi-Year Commitment Share on Refunded Web Hosting Plans Renewals
content:
## Multi-year commitment share — Web Hosting Plans auto-renew refunds

**Rule.** The auto-renew refund amount keeps back a multi-year commitment share decided by the months the refunded line covered:

- a 36-month line keeps back one month at the tier's 1-month price (no commitment);
- a 24-month line keeps back one year's multi-year saving, which is 12 times the difference between the tier's regular 12-month rate and its regular 24-month rate;
- a 12-month line keeps back no commitment share.

The rates are those of the plan's tier in the Web Hosting Plans price schedule.

| Months covered by the refunded line | Commitment share kept back |
|---|---|
| 36 | the tier's 1-month price, once |
| 24 | 12 multiplied by (regular 12-month rate less regular 24-month rate) |
| 12 | none |

**Worked example (hypothetical tier rates: 1-month price USD 21.40, regular 12-month USD 10.85, regular 24-month USD 9.60).** A refunded 24-month line keeps back 12 multiplied by USD 1.25, that is USD 15.00. A refunded 36-month line on the same tier keeps back USD 21.40. A refunded 12-month line keeps back nothing.
